title: ✉️ Task 1.1 — Do'stona xat (Informal Letter)
lesson:
✉️ *Task 1.1 — Do'stona (Informal) xat*

📏 *Hajmi: 50 so'z atrofida (40-60 so'z oralig'ida)*

1️⃣ *Salomlashish:* Dear [Ism],
2️⃣ *Kirish:* Qisqa hol-ahvol so'rash yoki xat sababini aytish
3️⃣ *Asosiy qism:* 1-2 gapda asosiy xabar — do'stona, erkin uslubda, qisqartmalar (I'm, it's) ishlatiladi
4️⃣ *Yakunlash:* Qisqa yakuniy gap
5️⃣ *Imzo:* Best wishes, / Love, — so'ng ismingiz

⚠️ *Muhim:* Task 1.1 juda qisqa — faqat asosiy fikrni yeting, ortiqcha tafsilotga o'tmang. So'z sonidan oshib ketish ball kamaytiradi.

🗣 *Foydali iboralar:*
— It was great to hear from you!
— Just a quick note to say...
— Anyway, I'd better go now.
— Write back soon!
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa (Task 1.1, ~50 so'z):* Do'stingizga xat yozing va uni tug'ilgan kuningizga taklif qiling. Sana va joyni aniq ko'rsating.

title: 📄 Task 1.2 — Rasmiy/Yarim-rasmiy xat
lesson:
📄 *Task 1.2 — Rasmiy/Yarim-rasmiy xat (Formal/Semi-formal Letter)*

📏 *Hajmi: 120-150 so'z*

1️⃣ *Salomlashish:* Dear Mr./Ms. [Familiya], yoki Dear Sir/Madam,
2️⃣ *Kirish:* Xat maqsadini aniq bildiring — "I am writing to inform/request/complain..."
3️⃣ *Asosiy qism (2-3 paragraf):* Har bir paragraf — bitta fikr, dalil bilan. Rasmiy uslub: qisqartmalar ishlatilmaydi.
4️⃣ *Yakunlash:* "I look forward to your response." / "Please do not hesitate to contact me."
5️⃣ *Imzo:* Yours faithfully, (ism noma'lum) / Yours sincerely, (ism ma'lum) — to'liq ism

⚠️ *Muhim:* 120 so'zdan kam yozsangiz — fikringiz yetarli rivojlantirilmagan hisoblanadi; 150 so'zdan oshsangiz — vaqtni noto'g'ri taqsimlagan bo'lasiz.

🗣 *Foydali iboralar:*
— I am writing to inform you that...
— I would be grateful if you could...
— Please find attached...
— Should you require further information, please contact me.
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa (Task 1.2, 120-150 so'z):* Muassasa ma'muriyatiga xat yozing — talabalar uchun qo'shimcha Business English kursi ochish taklifini bildiring, buning foydalarini kamida 2 ta dalil bilan asoslang.

title: 🔄 Task 2 — Paraphrasing (Essay ichida)
lesson:
🔄 *Paraphrasing — fikrni boshqa so'zlar bilan ifodalash*

📏 *Task 2 insholari uchun hajm: 180-200 so'z*

Insho savolini so'zma-so'z takrorlamaslik kerak — buning o'rniga uni **o'z so'zlaringiz bilan** qayta ifodalaysiz (odatda kirish qismida ishlatiladi).

*Usullar:*
1️⃣ *Sinonim ishlatish:* important → crucial/essential
2️⃣ *So'z turkumini o'zgartirish:* to decide (fe'l) → decision (ot)
3️⃣ *Gap tuzilishini o'zgartirish:* Active → Passive

*Namuna:*
Original: "Many people think that social media has a negative effect on teenagers."
Paraphrase: "It is widely believed that social networking platforms negatively influence young people."
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa (180-200 so'z):* Quyidagi gapni avval paraphrase qiling, so'ng shu fikr asosida to'liq insho yozing: "Companies should invest more in employee training to increase productivity."

title: 🔗 Task 2 — Bog'lovchilar (Linking Words)
lesson:
🔗 *Insholarda bog'lovchilar (Linking Words)*

📏 *Hajm: 180-200 so'z*

Fikrlarni bir-biriga bog'lash uchun ishlatiladi — matningizni mantiqiy va oqimli qiladi.

*Qo'shimcha fikr:* Furthermore, Moreover, In addition, Also
*Qarama-qarshilik:* However, On the other hand, Nevertheless, Although
*Sabab-natija:* Therefore, As a result, Consequently, Due to
*Misol keltirish:* For example, For instance, Such as
*Xulosa:* In conclusion, To sum up, Overall

*Namuna:*
"Remote work offers flexibility. **However**, it can also lead to isolation. **Therefore**, companies should organize regular team meetings."
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa (180-200 so'z):* "Advantages and disadvantages of working from home" mavzusida to'liq insho yozing, kamida 5 xil bog'lovchi ishlatib.

title: 💡 Task 2 — Fikrni dalillash (Supporting Ideas)
lesson:
💡 *Fikrni dalillar bilan qo'llab-quvvatlash*

📏 *Hajm: 180-200 so'z*

Har bir fikringiz **dalil, misol yoki statistika** bilan asoslanishi kerak — aks holda insho zaif ko'rinadi.

*Tuzilma:* Fikr (Topic sentence) → Tushuntirish (Explanation) → Misol/dalil (Example/Evidence)

*Foydali iboralar:*
— This is mainly because...
— A good example of this is...
— Research shows that...
— This can be illustrated by...
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa (180-200 so'z):* "Investing in staff training improves company performance" fikrini oling va to'liq insho yozing, kamida 2 ta dalil/misol bilan asoslab.

title: ⚖ Task 2 — Problem & Solution Essay
lesson:
⚖ *Problem and Solution Essay — tuzilishi*

📏 *Hajm: 180-200 so'z*

1️⃣ *Kirish:* Muammoni tanishtiring
2️⃣ *Asosiy qism 1:* Muammo(lar)ni tasvirlang va sabablarini tushuntiring
3️⃣ *Asosiy qism 2:* Yechim(lar)ni taklif qiling, har birini asoslang
4️⃣ *Xulosa:* Fikrlarni umumlashtiring, eng samarali yechimni ta'kidlang

*Foydali iboralar:*
— One of the main problems is...
— This has led to...
— A possible solution would be to...
— In order to solve this issue...
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa (180-200 so'z):* "Unemployment among young graduates in Uzbekistan" mavzusida muammoni tasvirlab, 2 ta yechim taklif qiling.

title: 🤝 Task 2 — Agree / Disagree Essay
lesson:
🤝 *Agree or Disagree Essay — tuzilishi*

📏 *Hajm: 180-200 so'z*

1️⃣ *Kirish:* Mavzuni tanishtiring, o'z pozitsiyangizni bildiring
2️⃣ *Asosiy qism 1:* Birinchi dalil + misol
3️⃣ *Asosiy qism 2:* Ikkinchi dalil + misol
4️⃣ *Xulosa:* Pozitsiyangizni qayta tasdiqlang

*Foydali iboralar:*
— I completely/partly agree that...
— From my point of view...
— Although some people argue that..., I believe...
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa (180-200 so'z):* "Companies should allow employees to work remotely full-time" fikri bilan roziligingizni/rozi emasligingizni yozing.

title: 📊 Task 2 — Advantages & Disadvantages Essay
lesson:
📊 *Advantages and Disadvantages Essay — tuzilishi*

📏 *Hajm: 180-200 so'z*

1️⃣ *Kirish:* Mavzuni tanishtiring
2️⃣ *Asosiy qism 1:* Afzalliklar (kamida 2 ta)
3️⃣ *Asosiy qism 2:* Kamchiliklar (kamida 2 ta)
4️⃣ *Xulosa:* Umumiy balansni bildiring

*Foydali iboralar:*
— One major advantage/benefit of... is that...
— On the other hand, a significant drawback is...
— Weighing up both sides, it seems that...
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa (180-200 so'z):* "Advantages and disadvantages of outsourcing business functions" mavzusida to'liq insho yozing.

title: 🆚 Task 2 — Comparison Essay ("Is it better...?")
lesson:
🆚 *Comparison Essay — tuzilishi*

📏 *Hajm: 180-200 so'z*

1️⃣ *Kirish:* Ikkala variantni tanishtiring
2️⃣ *Asosiy qism 1:* Birinchi variant
3️⃣ *Asosiy qism 2:* Ikkinchi variant
4️⃣ *Xulosa:* Qaysi biri afzalroq ekanini aniq bildiring

*Foydali iboralar:*
— Compared to..., ... is...
— Both options have their merits, however...
— All things considered, ... is the better choice because...
taskPrompt: ✍ *Vazifa (180-200 so'z):* "Is it better to work for a large corporation or a small startup?" mavzusida to'liq insho yozing.
